Joins Montgomery tracts with EPA facility counts and CDC PLACES adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents using total population, filters to tracts with both values, and returns the correlation and paired tract count ordered by facility density.
sql:
WITH epa AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS facility_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_c9085b'
    AND source = 'm1_cdc'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS asthma_prev
  FROM session.fw_c9085b_m2_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         COALESCE(e.facility_count, 0) AS facility_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         CASE WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0
              THEN (CAST(COALESCE(e.facility_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000
         END AS epa_rate_per_1000,
         h.asthma_prev
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN epa e ON e.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM base
  WHERE epa_rate_per_1000 IS NOT NULL
    AND asthma_prev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name,
       epa_rate_per_1000,
       facility_count,
       totalpopulation,
       asthma_prev,
       CORR(epa_rate_per_1000, asthma_prev) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_rate_per_1000 DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
